recent.statement: A flash flood warning will be issued for the state of Arizona within the next week
recent.evidence: All flash flood warning signals for Arizona (S2–S7) are dated July 12–17, 2026, before the forecast window opened on July 22, and no signal documents a warning issued between July 22 and July 29, 2026.

recent.statement: Tropical Cyclone NOUL-26 will intensify to Category 3 within 24 hours
recent.evidence: The only intensity-related signal for NOUL-26 (S3) cites Category 1 (120 km/h) wind impacts after landfall in China, and no signal shows the storm reaching Category 3 within the 24-hour window.

recent.statement: VIX fear gauge will spike above 20 due to Gaza conflict escalation
recent.evidence: The current VIX snapshot shows 18.21 (-2.46%), below the stated 20 threshold, and no signal shows a Gaza-driven spike above 20 during the window.

recent.statement: Kerch Strait ship transits will drop below 1 daily due to escalating Ukraine war tensions
recent.evidence: Kerch Strait recorded 2 daily ship transits during the window, which is above the forecast threshold of below 1.

recent.statement: A volcanic eruption occurs at Nevados del Chillan Volcano, Chile, triggered by seismic activity near Mendoza, Argentina.
recent.evidence: No signal shows an eruption at Nevados del Chillán during the 28–29 July 2026 window, let alone one triggered by seismic activity near Mendoza; all web items predate the forecast (June 2026 or earlier) and only describe ongoing activity or hazard status.

recent.statement: A major earthquake will occur in the Pacific-Antarctic Ridge within the next week
recent.evidence: None of the signals dates a major (M≥6-plus) Pacific-Antarctic Ridge earthquake to the 22–29 July 2026 window; the USGS event pages listed are undated historical events and no in-window seismic signal shows such a quake.

recent.statement: The EIA weekly petroleum status report will move CL=F by at least 1.5% on the day of its release, July 22nd.
recent.evidence: No signal reports any CL=F price move magnitude on July 22, 2026; the signals only confirm report scheduling/publication, so the claimed ≥1.5% move is unsupported after the window closed.

recent.statement: The VIX fear gauge will spike above 22 within 24 hours due to escalation in Israeli-Lebanon conflict
recent.evidence: The only signal shows VIX at 18.21 and falling, well below the 22 threshold, so the forecast spike did not occur within the window.

recent.statement: Hurricane Genevieve will intensify to Category 3 strength within 24 hours, threatening Mexico's Gulf Coast
recent.evidence: Genevieve was a Pacific hurricane east of the Gulf that reached Category 5 but was explicitly not expected to make landfall, so the forecast's stated threat to Mexico's Gulf Coast did not occur.

recent.statement: Flash flooding will occur in the Nashville area within the next week
recent.evidence: S2, dated 2026-07-22 within the forecast window, states Nashville Fire crews rescued stranded residents in knee-deep flash flooding, showing flash flooding occurred in the Nashville area.

recent.statement: The Federal Reserve will raise interest rates at the FOMC meeting on July 28th
recent.evidence: S1 confirms only that the FOMC meeting was scheduled for 2026-07-28, and no signal — including the [web] headlines — states that the Federal Reserve actually raised interest rates.

recent.statement: Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting on 2026-07-28 will signal a 25-basis-point rate hike to combat inflationary pressures.
recent.evidence: No signal states the FOMC announced or signaled a 25-basis-point rate hike; the web headlines only reference the scheduled July 28-29 meeting and market speculation, with no reported hike decision.

self_calibration.note: Published headline probability is RAW conviction (unchanged); this is the honest companion. Calibration fixes overconfidence, not discrimination — see /calibration.
